status: AUDIT STAGING ONLY — nothing here is ADOPTED into any forecast. Adoption is gated behind delegate review at the spec stage (Order of work step 4).
sealed_window: 2025-01 .. 2026-07 (SEALED; enforced at model read, not by truncating these raw files)

series.first_public: H.15 released each business day ~16:15 ET for the PRIOR business day's trade date.
series.pit_usable: value labelled date D is first knowable ~D+1 16:15 ET (~D+1 20:15 UTC). Use the most recent release known at t.
series.notes: Constant-maturity yield, percent. NaN on non-trading days.

series.first_public: H.15 released each business day ~16:15 ET for the PRIOR business day's trade date.
series.pit_usable: value labelled date D first knowable ~D+1 16:15 ET.

series.first_public: H.10 daily broad index, released next business day.
series.pit_usable: value date D knowable ~D+1. Use most recent release at t.
series.notes: NOT ICE U.S. Dollar Index (DXY). ICE DXY is proprietary/licensed. This is the Fed nominal broad trade-weighted USD index — a documented free substitute, STAGED NOT ADOPTED. Basket and weights differ from DXY (adds CNY, MXN, etc.).

series.first_public: Official daily close published by CBOE at end of the US cash session (~16:15 ET / ~20:15 UTC) for date D.
series.pit_usable: close for date D knowable ~D 20:15 UTC (same day). Intraday VIX is disseminated live but only the close is here.

series.first_public: Mirrors CBOE close; FRED disseminates next morning.
series.pit_usable: close date D; if pulled live from FRED, arrives D+1 AM.
series.notes: Close-only cross-check against cboe_VIX. Prefer CBOE for OHLC.

series.first_public: Index close for date D known at US cash close ~16:00 ET; FRED series updates next morning.
series.pit_usable: cash close date D knowable ~D 20:00 UTC. NOTE: cash index has NO overnight/Globex session, so it misses moves that occur between US close and the crypto decision cut.
series.notes: NOT the ES future. CME ES futures (which trade ~23h and are the state variable actually named in §68.9) are proprietary. Cash index is a free substitute, STAGED NOT ADOPTED. Rolling 10y window means pre-~2016 history is unavailable from this feed.

series.first_public: Index close for date D known at US cash close; FRED updates next morning.
series.pit_usable: cash close date D knowable ~D 20:00 UTC. Same overnight-gap caveat as SP500.
series.notes: NOT the NQ future. CME NQ futures proprietary. Cash index is a free substitute, STAGED NOT ADOPTED. History reaches ~2015 here.
